messages:
Here is the proposed patch for `_codev/config.yaml`:

```
--- context: (current) ---
Rust project.

--- context: (proposed) ---
Single-crate Rust library (edition 2021): `slugify` turns a title into a URL slug.
Only dependency is unicode-normalization (NFD decomposition, then non-ASCII is dropped,
not transliterated). Public API is a single panic-free function `slugify(&str) -> String`
that returns no Result. Comments are in English: `//!` for the crate and `///` doc comments
that state the output contract (allowed characters, separator).
```

```
--- rules: (current) ---
(empty)

--- rules: (proposed) ---
specs:
  - Each requirement gives at least one input title and its exact expected slug,
    e.g. "Été à Paris" → "ete-a-paris".
design:
  - State how the change affects the output contract of slugify (allowed characters,
    dash separator, accent handling) and whether it is backward compatible for
    existing slugs.
tasks:
  - Each task names the input → slug example that proves it is done.
  - "Unit tests go in the #[cfg(test)] mod tests of src/lib.rs, one #[test] per behavior,
     named after that behavior (e.g. accents_are_dropped), using assert_eq! on
     slugify(input). Check with cargo test, cargo clippy -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check."
```

> Apply this patch to `_codev/config.yaml`? [yes/no]

*(Evaluation run: the answer is « no ».)*

I didn't make any changes. Run `/codev-configure` again whenever you want to retry.

There was nothing else to read: the project has no CONTRIBUTING, no `docs/` and no CI workflow, so I based the proposal on `README.md`, `Cargo.toml` and `src/lib.rs`.
